correctness.rationale: For x>0 the first coordinates satisfy x_{n+2}=T x_{n+1}-D x_n until first nonpositive x_k; the map then gives exactly two further steps to zero (including x_k=0). In the oscillatory region the roots sqrt(D)e^{±iθ} generate a sine sequence; every positive run exits by ceil(pi/θ) and an explicit initial phase realizes the last possible exit, yielding sharp uniform nilpotency. Repeated-root and distinct-positive-root solutions have monotonic affine or exponential brackets and yield exactly the claimed persistence cone and ceiling formulas. All initial points with x<=0 are handled by the reset branch. Independently checked exact rational iteration over representative grids, critical and overdamped thresholds and sharp witnesses; this does not prove the all-real-parameter statement.

Simpson 2024 studies a containing degenerate border-collision normal form but describes the forcing-zero parameter slice as outside its principal analysis; the full revised journal version was not separately compared. Published Resultary nearby fixed-initial-state reset oscillator concerns different forcing and thresholds, not an implication covering these exact all-initial extinction laws.
